name: tom-secrets-browser-extension
description: The Tom Secrets Manager browser extension (Manifest V3, Chromium browsers and Firefox): the site's logins from the vaults through the native-messaging host tsm-browser-host, the candidate list in the page, the fill on a click or the shortcut.
author: Peter Nicolai Alexis Kyaw

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node tool/test.mjs
